value: Lei nº 8.245 of 18 October 1991 on leases of urban property (Lei do Inquilinato), as amended.
note: Portuguese text of Lei nº 8.245/1991 (Lei do Inquilinato) as compiled by the Federal Senate, with amendment notes (e.g. Lei 11.196/2005, 12.112/2009, 12.744/2012). Not every later amendment was checked one by one; check the current version on planalto.gov.br.

value: A lease may be agreed for any term; a term of ten years or more needs the spouse's consent (Art. 3).
note: Portuguese text of Lei nº 8.245/1991 (Lei do Inquilinato) as compiled by the Federal Senate, with amendment notes (e.g. Lei 11.196/2005, 12.112/2009, 12.744/2012). Not every later amendment was checked one by one; check the current version on planalto.gov.br.

value: During the agreed term the landlord may not take the property back; the tenant may return it by paying the agreed penalty, proportional to the time served (Art. 4).
note: Portuguese text of Lei nº 8.245/1991 (Lei do Inquilinato) as compiled by the Federal Senate, with amendment notes (e.g. Lei 11.196/2005, 12.112/2009, 12.744/2012). Not every later amendment was checked one by one; check the current version on planalto.gov.br.

value: The tenant may end an open-ended lease by written notice of at least 30 days; without notice the landlord may claim one month's rent and charges (Art. 6).
note: Portuguese text of Lei nº 8.245/1991 (Lei do Inquilinato) as compiled by the Federal Senate, with amendment notes (e.g. Lei 11.196/2005, 12.112/2009, 12.744/2012). Not every later amendment was checked one by one; check the current version on planalto.gov.br.

value: The parties may agree a new rent or add or change an adjustment clause (Art. 18). Without agreement, after three years of the lease or of the last agreement, either party may ask the court to revise the rent to market level (Art. 19).
note: Portuguese text of Lei nº 8.245/1991 (Lei do Inquilinato) as compiled by the Federal Senate, with amendment notes (e.g. Lei 11.196/2005, 12.112/2009, 12.744/2012). Not every later amendment was checked one by one; check the current version on planalto.gov.br.

value: Except in listed cases and holiday lets, the landlord may not require rent in advance (Art. 20). Unless agreed otherwise, rent is due by the sixth working day of the following month (Art. 23, I).
note: Portuguese text of Lei nº 8.245/1991 (Lei do Inquilinato) as compiled by the Federal Senate, with amendment notes (e.g. Lei 11.196/2005, 12.112/2009, 12.744/2012). Not every later amendment was checked one by one; check the current version on planalto.gov.br.

value: The landlord may require one guarantee: a deposit (caução), a guarantor (fiança), rent-guarantee insurance or assignment of investment-fund units; more than one guarantee in the same lease is void (Art. 37).
note: Portuguese text of Lei nº 8.245/1991 (Lei do Inquilinato) as compiled by the Federal Senate, with amendment notes (e.g. Lei 11.196/2005, 12.112/2009, 12.744/2012). Not every later amendment was checked one by one; check the current version on planalto.gov.br.

value: A cash deposit may not exceed three months' rent and is placed in a savings account, with the returns going to the tenant (Art. 38, para. 2).
note: Portuguese text of Lei nº 8.245/1991 (Lei do Inquilinato) as compiled by the Federal Senate, with amendment notes (e.g. Lei 11.196/2005, 12.112/2009, 12.744/2012). Not every later amendment was checked one by one; check the current version on planalto.gov.br.

value: The landlord must hand over the property fit for use, guarantee peaceful use, answer for defects existing before the lease, give an itemised receipt, pay administration and agency fees and pay property taxes and fire insurance unless agreed otherwise (Art. 22).
note: Portuguese text of Lei nº 8.245/1991 (Lei do Inquilinato) as compiled by the Federal Senate, with amendment notes (e.g. Lei 11.196/2005, 12.112/2009, 12.744/2012). Not every later amendment was checked one by one; check the current version on planalto.gov.br.

field: End of lease of 30 months or more
value: A written lease of 30 months or more ends at the end of the term without notice; if the tenant stays more than 30 days without objection it continues for an indefinite term, and the landlord may then end it at any time giving 30 days to vacate (Art. 46).
note: Portuguese text of Lei nº 8.245/1991 (Lei do Inquilinato) as compiled by the Federal Senate, with amendment notes (e.g. Lei 11.196/2005, 12.112/2009, 12.744/2012). Not every later amendment was checked one by one; check the current version on planalto.gov.br.

value: A lease shorter than 30 months is extended automatically for an indefinite term, and the landlord may recover the property only on listed grounds, such as own or family use, licensed works, or after five years of uninterrupted lease (Art. 47).
note: Portuguese text of Lei nº 8.245/1991 (Lei do Inquilinato) as compiled by the Federal Senate, with amendment notes (e.g. Lei 11.196/2005, 12.112/2009, 12.744/2012). Not every later amendment was checked one by one; check the current version on planalto.gov.br.

value: In listed eviction actions, if the tenant agrees to leave, the court sets six months to vacate from service (Art. 61).
